comparison.objective: Adjusts a cabinet hinge side cam for even reveals and closes the flap for inspection; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1865 uses a slotted driver on one of several cam heads and then articulates the door; the candidate coordinates two concentric tools against locknut reaction.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1865 checks closed reveal equality, flushness, no sag, and released stability; the candidate checks nut seating, 90° opening retention, drift, and three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both adjust and functionally inspect an articulated mechanism, but PR-1865 has no separate locking operation whose torque can disturb the chosen setting.

review_notes: Cabinet flap side screw adjustment then close and reveal verification. Compare outcome adjustment and locking/coupling; original uses real driver slot contact with software cam mapping.
